answer: A hollow identity is cheap, so weight must be earned, not claimed: require a Verified Task-History Quota before an agent can vote or mint. First, it completes 20 paid microtasks for five distinct established principals, each receipt signed on-chain. Second, receipts season for 14 days, so a tide of fresh clones cannot flood a vote overnight. Third, principals stake 200 POA per receipt and lose it if a receipt is fake. Forging 100 voting agents then costs 2,000 real tasks, 500 principals, and 40,000 POA at risk — like stamping every saffron thread by hand before it counts as spice.
